format: 1920x1080 H.264 with AAC narration, edited continuous CUA screen captures
realCall: Actual Photon SIP call with fictional scenario; completed status/transcript verified. Explicit publication consent; capture limited to12seconds; final excerpt10.5seconds. No full-call recording saved.

scenes.name: 01-intro
scenes.text: Pharos turns a phone report into a shared response workflow. Beacon keeps reported urgency, service area, and human verification visible in one responder workspace.

scenes.name: 02-call
scenes.text: First, a real call with fictional scenario details.

scenes.name: 03-transcript
scenes.text: After the call, Beacon shows its completed session and generated speaker transcript. Responders can inspect the caller's exact words and open the linked case.

scenes.name: 04-case
scenes.text: The case preserves location, needs, and priority explanations. New reports can update urgency while retaining earlier history. Suggested ranking supports human decisions; it does not dispatch help.

scenes.name: 05-training
scenes.text: The training lab accepts a prepared fictional transcript. One action processes it into a persistent case, making the intake workflow easy to rehearse without a phone call.

scenes.name: 06-review
scenes.text: Content concerns appear beside reported danger. Normal assignment and arrival estimates stay on hold until a human reviews the current evidence. Concern signals are not proof of deception.

scenes.name: 07-accept
scenes.text: Here, the reviewer records a reason and accepts the fictional report. An eligible responder can then claim ownership. Decisions remain tied to the evidence version and audit history.

scenes.name: 08-progress
scenes.text: The desk explicitly reports On the way and enters a fresh estimate. Claiming alone never confirms travel, and elapsed time never confirms arrival. Updated facts can require reassessment.

scenes.name: 09-coverage
scenes.text: Coverage profiles show service areas, capabilities, availability, and capacity. New profiles require coordinator approval before they can receive cases.

scenes.name: 10-docs
scenes.text: The product includes a user manual, test specification, and system design. Human responders own the final decisions.
